mentions.name: Ledga
mentions.description: A budgeting app called Ledga that shows the user's immediate financial past and forecasts the future, aimed at people living paycheck to paycheck. It ships as a desktop app with a companion mobile web app, offers a free 60-day trial, and subscription and Plaid features are coming soon.
mentions.problem: People living check to check lack a clear view of their immediate financial past and forecast future.
mentions.audience: People living paycheck to paycheck who need visibility into their immediate financial past and future.
mentions.source_excerpt: A budget app called Ledga that shows your immediate past and forecast future for people living check to check. Desktop app with companion mobile web app.

evidence.value: A budget app called Ledga that shows your immediate past and forecast future for people living check to check. Desktop app with companion mobile web app.
